prompt: I have feature specifications in D:\twtaiworkshop\TWTAI-DocIntelligence-DraftGen\resources folder. Please generate product documentation from these files and create HTML output in the output folder. Include all features found in the specification files.

assertions.name: html_files_created
assertions.description: HTML output files are created for each feature found

assertions.name: correct_file_naming
assertions.description: HTML files follow the <Feature-Name>output.html naming convention

assertions.name: contains_feature_name
assertions.description: Each HTML contains the feature name as a heading

assertions.name: contains_description
assertions.description: Each HTML contains a brief description of what the feature does

assertions.name: contains_access_instructions
assertions.description: Each HTML contains 'How to Access' section with step-by-step instructions

assertions.name: contains_ui_options
assertions.description: Each HTML documents UI options with descriptions and defaults where applicable

assertions.name: valid_html_structure
assertions.description: Generated HTML is valid and well-formed

assertions.name: docx_handling
assertions.description: Any .docx files are skipped and user is informed

assertions.name: professional_formatting
assertions.description: Documentation follows technical writing standards with clear formatting and language
